frozenPlan.instructions: Search for a high-value complete plan: choose exactly one option per stage, in stage order. Option is eligible iff BOTH directed paths of its fragment F{id} exist in the original source graph. Paths require at least one edge. Costs and risks add, obey both limits. Value sums current goal values plus every bonus whose two options are selected. Maximize value. Different branches deliberately share conjunction fragments and their path derivations. Use verified facts when available; they are valid only for this source digest. A reference to an established fact does not require a new derivation. Reason about eligibility and useful alternatives, delegate arithmetic and prefix checks to tools, do not internally enumerate all combinations. In your first response evaluate at least one complete candidate and inspect two different prefixes. At most two reasoning construction/refinement calls then one non-thinking final submit. The controller gives final submit only best evaluated candidate, never optimum. Same total budget 65536 gross input+output tokens including thinking, all repeated inputs and evidence; at most 32 tool calls, 8192 output tokens per construction call. For auditability, when your reasoning establishes or reuses an eligibility claim, identify F{id}, and path endpoints. Distinguish a derivation from simply citing a checked result; do not invent derivations merely to satisfy audit instructions. Optimize best found, not proof of global optimum.

tools.name: fragment
tools.description: Check conjunction F{id}, returning two independently checked path requirements and a source-bound certificate.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Check a partial choice (one option per ordered stage); return feasible next options. No optimum access.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Check complete selection; return value/cost/risk. Maximize value, obey budgets and fragment eligibility.

frozenPlan.annotationRubric: Annotate ONLY the supplied model reasoning text, in chronological order. You are blind to experiment arm, grade and token use. F{id} means BOTH directed path requirements specified in needs. Extract short EXACT contiguous quotes containing actual reasoning about those path facts/conjunctions, not unrelated value arithmetic. For each quote give fragment integer id (or null if only a path is mentioned), claim string, paths as endpoint integer pairs, kind: derive, reuse, mention, conditional_recheck, uncertain. Add ready boolean for a conjunction conclusion, otherwise null. Add premiseEdges: the actual ordered direct edges stated in this quote as support (empty if support is only the two path requirements). Do not silently fill missing edge chains from source data. derive requires a conclusion plus actual support/premise chain or conjunction reasoning, not merely listing a known truth. reuse explicitly cites an established/checkable result without deriving it. mention has no inference. conditional_recheck depends on a changed selection/budget/goal condition and is not duplicate proof. uncertain is ambiguous. Set prior to index of an earlier annotation ONLY when this is a new derivation of the SAME conclusion from SAME premises and SAME source context; then kind must be derive. First derivation has prior null; two different branches with same source-bound qualification can be duplicates; simply restating an ID is not. Never infer unseen thinking. Include every explicit relevant episode you can identify, retaining uncertain cases. Quotes must occur verbatim in the text; occurrence is zero-based occurrence number when same quote occurs multiple times. Claim truth is not your authority: native raw-source check validates endpoints/fragment separately. Omit an episode rather than invent an absent span. Return annotations via annotate tool. Full text is reviewed even if truncated by provider; completeness of semantic extraction is unvalidated.
frozenPlan.inputReservation: compact request UTF-8 bytes +4096 +128 per input item; empirical conservative reserve, actual provider gross usage authoritative; fail-stop on overshoot/unknown usage. Prefix discounts do not discount token budget.
frozenPlan.qualityEndpoint: best independently verified candidate and submitted candidate separately; never successful task without valid submit; retain censoring/errors/missing submission.
frozenPlan.buildScope: New native bridge/independent raw-source exhaustive grader against inherited frozen production candidate kernel and dependencies; current candidate source bytes checked; not full checkout build.
frozenPlan.causalBoundary: Baseline sees raw task/edges/needs but no initial admitted packet; fragment tool available in all arms. Fresh/retained have byte-identical packets and policy: state-only contrast measures native work; stochastic thinking differences are descriptive.
frozenPlan.annotationScope: Direct external model reasoning text, blinded same-provider non-thinking annotator, source anchored exact quotes and prior links, native truth checks; extraction completeness/inter-rater agreement not established. No hidden/unreturned thought inferred. Annotation cost separate measurement overhead, never solver budget.
frozenPlan.failurePolicy: Exclusive raw files, no solver or annotation retries, unknown usage/invalid spans retained; no post-outcome task or rubric changes.
frozenPlan.design: 2 fixed seven-stage tasks, 2 changed goals each, 3 arms, 12 phases. Two construction/refinement calls and one final submit. No paid calibration or task selection.
